title: E-GRV-0104: a front witness calibrated on the husk alone, the time the change behind a hopping rod reaches a third...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0104 in the gravity arena: a front witness calibrated on the husk alone, the time the change behind a hopping rod reaches a third of the front's height (the Airy point, where a dispersive front's smear drops out), reads the husk alone at 1.0023 c where fractions of a maximum read 1.17 to 1.40 c, and reads the warped stack at 0.980 c, never above c but 2.02 percent under against a 2 percent gate, fail on F2 by a hair: the stack's level behind the front is only 0.55 to 0.65 of the husk's height, so a third of the husk's height comes later; the one-clock control reads 1.126 c, so the witness sees a superluminal bulk where there is one; every run exact and reversed bit for bit.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
